shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' app/ProductGrid.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' app/ProductSkeleton.tsx && sed -n '1,280p' app/globals.css && cat package.json && sed -n '1,160p' app/layout.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- app/NavigationTransitions.tsx app/layout.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' app/globals.css && sed -n '1,220p' app/NavigationTransitions.tsx && sed -n '1,120p' app/ProductGrid.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- app/ProductGrid.tsx app/layout.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' app/globals.css"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- package.json && git status --short package-lock.json && git diff --numstat -- package-lock.json && git diff -- app/NavigationTransitions.tsx'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat -- app/NavigationTransitions.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/globals.css app/layout.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' && git diff -- app/layout.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' && sed -n '1,220p' app/NavigationTransitions.tsx"
